result:
Round 237 is planned and dispatched as **SABA-B-11a-FIX-2**. The decision is **CONTINUE**.

**Round 236:** C passed it with real browser checks at both screen sizes (16 rows, 0 blocked). The root gate published it as `ecaf0e4`, which is the baseline for round 237. That closes GATE235-S1, A-R235-REVIEW-M1 and C-R235-01. The old task is copied to `tasks/round-236.md`.

**Round 237 fixes three related bugs:**
- **A-R234-REVIEW-M1** (Medium, with B-R235-READY-CLOBBER merged in): when the demo sounds finish loading, the "Demo collection ready…" line overwrites whatever the user just did, such as "clip added, tempo 120, Snap on". I reproduced it every time on the baseline by delaying the two demo MP3s by 4 seconds. I also found a second overwrite: the "Loading…" line wipes the tempo message written when a project opens with a BPM clip.
- **The status rule I set:**
  - "Ready" only replaces the "Loading…" text.
  - A load failure always shows. I tried adding the failure after the existing text, but it wrapped to two lines at 1280×720, so the failure replaces it.
  - "Loading…" keeps a line that already starts with it.
- **GATE234-S2** (Low): the tempo search no longer runs on every edit when no sound has a BPM.
- **GATE234-S3** (Low): no stray leading space in the status line.
- **Docs:** the round also corrects the two SABA-B-11a docs that describe this code, including C-R236-02 (doc 183's outdated `playFromRuler` bullet).

**Pre-check:** I tried the fix on a scratch copy of the code, outside `store/`. All 121 related test files (1,715 tests) pass, and 4 of the 5 planted faults make a test fail. The fifth behaves the same either way, so it isn't required. In Chromium at both sizes, the user's status now survives the ready message. Every race check only counts if the status still reads "Loading…" at the moment of the click, so a slow first load can't produce a false pass. Nothing in `store/` was changed: it is still at `ecaf0e4` with a clean tree, and the protected login and purchase files are frozen.

**Other updates:**
- `backlog.json` is now v222, with decisions D-29z339…D-29z345 and 379 entries in the low-priority polish list.
- **Moved to the polish list:** C-R236-01 and three other Lows from round 236. They are in code this round doesn't own.
- **Architecture:** two new structural notes are recorded as backlog signals and added to the pending tempo/grid architecture checkpoint request. They are not scheduled.
- `feature-status.md` is updated. `b-round-236.md` and `b-next.json` are written; `lessons.md` is unchanged.

**What's next:** round 238 is SABA-B-11b (the grid that adapts to zoom), unless the regression round falls due on or after 2026-10-30. There is no Critical or High bug open. Root is asked to run the tempo/grid architecture review (`b-round-234-checkpoint-request.md`) before 11b.

**For Saba:** one new question, SABA-Q-READY-AFTER-ACTION. If someone acts before loading finishes, they won't see the "Press ? for shortcuts" line that session. SABA-B-7 is still waiting for his answer.

**Advisor:** I consulted it before writing and again before handover, and followed its advice except on the failure-message rule, where my measurement decided. No Ableton manual section covers this status behaviour; the search found only an old forum thread ([forum.ableton.com](https://forum.ableton.com/viewtopic.php?p=69434)).

The policy file `agent-workflow.md` on disk is still older than the policy I was given; I followed the newer one and asked root to reconcile them.
